**Job Description Summary

**As a Service Account Leader at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in growing our service business across Denmark. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth across our Imaging, Ultrasound, and Patient Care Solutions portfolio. The role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• Develop account penetration strategies for key target accounts and competitive accounts. Share market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements with the wider business.

• Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets by maintaining accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, prioritizing selling time effectively, increasing sales volume, deepening account penetration, and ensuring comprehensive territory coverage.

• Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• At least one of the following core experiences:

• Consultative sales or marketing experience, including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decision-makers and influencers.

• Healthcare service experience, preferably in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound, or Patient Care Solutions.

• Experience in one or more customer-facing roles.

• Excellent written and spoken Danish and English language skills.

• Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• Robust interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently as well as with a team.

• Strong written and verbal communication and clear thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

**Inclusion and Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviours

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**About The Role

**We are looking for Senior DevOps engineer with deep expertise in CI/CD to join our Platform Engineering team in Copenhagen.

This role is focused on modernizing how software is built, tested, packaged, delivered, and deployed across Keepit. You will help define the standards, tooling, and practices that engineering teams across the company use to build and deliver software.

Experience designing CI/CD solutions for multiple teams and working effectively with the engineers who use them is essential for this role.

**You will:

**

• Build reusable GitLab CI/CD components and pipelines used across engineering teams.

• Build and operate highly available platform services and engineering infrastructure, including AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform-based infrastructure, and other services depended on by engineering teams. Our infrastructure spans Proxmox and Kubernetes.

• Create clear, durable documentation that helps engineers understand how our platform works, why decisions were made, and how to use it effectively.

• Operate the runner infrastructure used to build, test, and deploy our software, keeping it reliable, efficient, and secure.

• Build automated tests and validation that allow us to upgrade and change the platform with confidence.

**About You

****Must-haves:

**

• Strong Linux fundamentals, particularly with Debian-based systems and APT.

• Deep understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience designing and maintaining pipelines; GitLab CI/CD experience is preferred.

• Hands-on experience with several of the technologies we use, including containers, Bash, Ansible, Kubernetes, and observability stacks such as LGTM.

• Experience designing tooling, pipelines, or infrastructure used by multiple engineering teams.

• Experience operating and evolving production systems, with the engineering judgment that comes from learning what works and what doesn't.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• You work carefully and conscientiously, particularly when making changes to systems that other engineers depend on.

**Nice-to-haves:

**

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing, DHCP, and firewalling.

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, particularly for development, operations, documentation, or knowledge sharing.

• A passion for creating a great developer experience.

• Personal projects, open-source contributions, homelabs, or other evidence of technical curiosity outside your primary responsibilities.

**About Us

**Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk. We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents. We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way.

**As we collaborate across locations, English is our primary language. Please submit your CV in English to support the review process.

****We offer:

**

• Competitive salary.

• Pension scheme.

• A modern, energetic global work environment.

• Flexible work-life balance supported by a hybrid working model.

• Regular team-building activities.

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• Compensation is based on experience and skill set.

We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. When applying for the vacancy, Keepit will process your personal data, and therefore we recommend that you also read our privacy policy, which describes our processing of personal data and your rights as a data subject.

jobs.occupation: DevOps / Platform Engineer — Reliability, Performance & Production Ownership
jobs.description:
DevOps / Platform Engineer — Fully Remote, Performance & Production Ownership

Want to work fully remotely with real freedom and ownership while operating high-throughput, low-latency systems that serve billions of shoppers?

For the right person, this is a high-trust role where you have flexibility in how you structure your work and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the technology behind billions of e-commerce experiences.

We’re building the infrastructure behind better e-commerce experiences for billions of shoppers every year.

Our systems serve more than 2,000 requests per second. Our in-house search engine delivers a p50 latency of sub-ms, while our entire infrastructure maintains 99.998% uptime.

We work with modern technology, use AI as a fundamental part of how we build, and continuously push the limits of reliability, performance, and innovation. Our goal is simple: connect e-commerce shoppers with the right products at the right time while helping merchants create a better customer experience and improve their bottom line.

We’re proud of the systems we’ve built—and we want someone who is excited to help make them even faster, more reliable, and more capable.

This job will be perfect for you if

• You enjoy operating high-throughput production systems where latency, reliability, and customer impact matter

• You care deeply about reliability, latency, throughput, and system performance

• You can investigate problems across infrastructure, application code, databases, queues, and networks

• You are comfortable reading, writing, debugging, and optimising production code

• You proactively identify failure scenarios before they become incidents

• You build automation and tooling instead of accepting repetitive manual work

• You enjoy improving CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and developer experience

• You have handled serious production incidents and understand the responsibility that comes with on-call

• You think beyond whether a deployment succeeded and care about how the system behaves afterwards

• You can communicate clearly during incidents and take ownership when things matter

• You are curious about new technology and enjoy finding better ways to build and operate systems

• You want to work closely with software engineers rather than treating infrastructure as a separate world

• You thrive in a remote environment where freedom is matched by responsibility

A normal day for you

No two days will be the same, but your work might include:

• Investigating why a service, query, or piece of application code is slower than it should be

• Improving the reliability and performance of systems serving thousands of requests per second

• Reviewing metrics, traces, logs, and alerts to identify issues before they affect customers

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

**In The Video, Please Tell Us

**

• Who you are

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• What you changed and the measurable result

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

The video does not need to be polished. Please don’t spend time producing a perfect presentation or reading a script. We want to see the real person, understand how you think, and hear about the work you have actually done.

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.

Join the fastest growing and most dedicated SuccessFactors team in the Nordics

We are looking for a Bid Manager to join our Copenhagen office. This is a role that sits at the heart of our commercial process, supporting the commercial team as they lead sales opportunities, and is well suited for someone who enjoys structure, thrives under deadlines, and wants to make our bid management function as sharp as possible.

At Gavdi, we believe HR technology should make work life better, not more complicated. As a trusted SAP SuccessFactors partner, we help organisations across Europe transform how they manage their people.

This role suits someone how is ready to own bid management independently and make sound judgement calls without needing much guidance. You will be the person others turn to when a bid needs to get done, and the one shaping how it gets done going forward. The role also leaves room to explore beyond the core bid work, picking up adjacent tasks and responsibilities as your interests and our needs evolve.

What you will do

Bid management (the core of the role)

• Support the bid process end to end, from qualification to submission, working closely with our Client Partners as they take the commercial lead on opportunities

• Own and continuously improve bid templates, boilerplate content and a reusable library of case studies and references

• Support the review and structuring of legal and contractual content in bids, flagging points that need legal or commercial sign-off

• Keep bid documentation organised, on brand and consistent in quality across opportunities

• Track bid status, deadlines and follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks

• Identify inefficiencies in how bids get done and drive practical improvements to tools, templates and ways of working

• Provide presales support by pulling together relevant collateral, prior references and standard solution write-ups

_Compliance support (a smaller part of the role)

_

• Support the upkeep of Gavdi’s certifications, including ISAE 3000 and ISO/IEC 27001

• Help prepare documentation and evidence ahead of audits

• Build general compliance awareness

What we are looking for

• Some experience in bid management, proposal coordination, presales support or related commercial roles. HR technology sector or consulting experience is a plus

• Good commercial understanding, comfortable reading and organising bids, terms and basic risk considerations

• Organised and structured, with the ability to juggle multiple bids and keep them on track

• Strong written communication skills, able to turn input from different teams into a clear and coherent document

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to build relationships and coordinate across the business without formal authority. Since you’ll be carrying this function on your own, your ability to connect with people across teams is what makes you effective, and it’s something you’ll get to build from the ground up.

• Comfortable working independently, making sound judgement on when to flag things up

• Eager to keep learning and to shape the role as it grows,

• Based in Copenhagen or the surrounding area

What we offer

• An informal workplace where you will learn from experienced colleagues from day one

• Real responsibility early on. We believe in giving people room to grow

• A visible role at the heart of the sales process, with genuine room to shape how bid management works

• A team culture built on knowledge sharing, collaboration and having each other’s backs

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a software developer in our turbine software team, you will play a key role in developing the embedded software that controls wind turbines. Your day will involve close collaboration with team members and stakeholders from around the world, working through the full software development lifecycle—from requirements clarification and implementation to testing and maintenance. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, participate in agile SCRUM teams, and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing. With a flexible work environment, you’ll have the opportunity to balance independent tasks with teamwork, both in the office and remotely.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop and maintain control software in C++ for Linux-based embedded systems, ensuring reliable operation of wind turbines.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Conduct comprehensive software testing, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests, employing strong CI/CD practices and AI-assisted programming.

• Refactor and enhance existing code to maintain fleet performance and participate in innovation initiatives such as code camps and ideation events.

• Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by following agile development principles within a SCRUM and SAFe environment.

What You Bring

• Academic degree in IT, Software, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in C/C++ software development.

• Proficiency in object-oriented programming, software testing, continuous integration, embedded control mechanisms, and middleware development for Linux-based x86 and ARM platforms, including Linux system hardening for cyber-security.

• A keen interest in control of mechanical areas such as aerodynamics, mechanics, hydraulics, and power electronics, with a passion for integrating hardware and software into safe, high-quality solutions.

• Experience working with real-time protocols (e.g., ProfiNet), version control systems (Git), task management tools (Jira), and agile development methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a structured and proactive approach, an ownership mindset, and a passion for delivering high-quality software solutions in the renewable energy sector.

About the Team

You’ll join a diverse and innovative team dedicated to advancing renewable energy through pioneering software solutions. We value collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning, working together in an agile environment to drive the success of our wind turbine projects. Our team thrives on mutual support, open communication, and a shared commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

**About The Role

**As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

**Your primary responsibilities will include:

**

• Coordination and handling of vessel port calls

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

**Who Are You

**Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

**What We Offer

**At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

• A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

What we do – Together we create solutions

We are a proud family-owned company, founded in Denmark in 1972, and a global provider of all logistics services within modern supply chain management. Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service. Blue Water Shipping is represented by more than 2,700 employees worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise, enabling us to offer complete and tailored solutions for any shipping need anywhere in the world.

****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD99977

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders and transformation teams, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the engagement

• Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

• Assess operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, data and digital workflows to identify opportunities for improvement

• Define target-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, business cases, success measures and benefits realization plans

• Lead executive workshops, facilitate decision-making and align stakeholders across complex organizations

• Advise customers on how Autodesk and complementary AECO technologies support business outcomes through effective workflows, data management and interoperability

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for data, automation and AI based on business value, organizational readiness, governance and adoption

• Partner with Solution Architects, technical consultants and customer-facing teams to shape advisory engagements, validate strategic recommendations and develop credible delivery roadmaps

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Substantial experience in AECO, management consulting or business transformation, with a proven track record of independently leading complex strategy and transformation engagements

• Deep expertise in at least one of the following: construction, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, utilities, or a closely related project-based, asset-intensive industry

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk technologies or comparable AECO tool ecosystems, with the ability to discuss capabilities, workflow fit, data, interoperability and business value. Hands-on implementation expertise is not required

• Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

• Proven experience advising executives, structuring complex problems, facilitating high-stakes workshops and driving decisions

****Learn More

******About Autodesk

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency

**Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Netherlands based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 69,000 EUR and 101,200 EUR. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. jobs.occupation: Sr. Director, Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead world-class expertise at the front of differentiating peptide and protein drug discovery? Do you want to impact the drug discovery strategy that helps new candidates move faster, more reliably and with stronger scientific confidence towards first human dose?

If so, this is a unique opportunity to advance molecular expression, bioanalysis and ADME science, accelerate drug innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases, and champion technological innovation and collaboration across boundaries to deliver exceptional performance across discovery and development.

**The Position

**As Sr. Director for Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME, you will lead two centres of excellence and set the direction for the area that enables novel peptide and protein candidates to move quickly and reliably towards first human dose (FHD). Your leadership will enhance molecular expression, PK and ADME science, safeguard critical timelines and strengthen the competitiveness of the discovery portfolio.

You will provide senior leadership for the Centre for Expression Engineering and the Centre for Bioanalysis & ADME, shaping strategy and delivery across the area. You will partner closely with Research Centres of Excellence (RCE), Therapeutic Discovery, Chemistry Manufacturing and Control (CMC), Global Research, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS), CROs and academic and biotech collaborators to keep projects progressing with clarity, quality and speed.

You will lead a team of Department Managers and Scientific Directors and, together with them, guide a high-performing, purpose-driven team of around 80 colleagues in total. As a member of the RCE leadership team, you will help move decisions forward and shaping the culture, represent the area in steering committees and sponsor initiatives that improve business outcomes and collaboration.

Location: Måløv, Denmark.

**What You’ll Do

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Inspire and empower department managers and teams through visionary leadership and meaningful mentorship, nurturing talent and creating opportunities for people to grow, thrive and succeed together.

• Build a high-capability, high-performance, challenge-safe and collaborative culture through role-modelling, talent development, succession planning and continuous efficiency improvements.

• Identify and sponsor cross-organisational initiatives that improve business outcomes, collaboration and research impact.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role in pharmaceutical drug discovery. To succeed, you will bring:

• A PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech research, including drug discovery and preclinical development.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Strong collaborative leadership, enterprise and pragmatic mindset and the ability to build partnerships across disciplines and with external partners.

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to optimise discovery and development.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Given the strong scientific expertise already embedded across the organization, direct experience in all technical disciplines is not essential. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.

The work moves at pace, combining scientific ambition with a strong performance culture where your contribution is recognised.

You will be part of a collaborative high-performing leadership team where people keep things informal, find creative solutions together and have fun along the way.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the science that gets competitive new drug candidates to patients faster, apply for the Sr. Director, EEBA role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Your benefits

As a modern workplace, we offer our employees a canteen, rooftop terrace, regular social and professional events, a very attractive benefits package including health and accident insurance, pension, and many other perks. As the Core Payments Platform modernises domestic and cross-border payments, this role gives you the chance to lead a cluster of five squads through a period of real transformation. You will combine functional and HR responsibility with ownership of a strategic commercial theme on our cross-border platform.

The area is undergoing significant change, driven by customer expectations, regulation and platform modernisation. In this role, you will set direction for the squads, build a strong leadership environment and establish effective governance around commercial cross-border initiatives. Your focus will be to turn strategy and commitments into coordinated delivery in 2027 and beyond.

• Setting direction for the cluster and aligning priorities with the tribe strategy

• Acting as Programme Manager (Theme Integrator) for commercial cross-border initiatives, coordinating scope, dependencies, risks and decisions
